versions.description_html:
Done can mean something different in the MES and in the ERP, and integration has to resolve that. In this episode of the iFAKT series, we examine how to align status, quantities and events across both systems.
You will learn how to design integrations that avoid conflicting numbers.
Who it is for: Integration architects, MES and ERP owners.
